$comment: Drift hotspots of the foundation, read by .claude/hooks/drift-reminder.mjs after every edit. paths: repo-relative globs. say: what the change makes untrue. docs: files to re-check, named only while they exist. The skills guard fails on a path here that does not exist. A product's own hotspots go in product.json; an optional feature's in <feature>.json.

hotspots.say: Prisma schema changed: regenerate the client and the enum mirror (pnpm --filter @appshore/db prisma:generate), add a forward migration that keeps existing rows (pnpm --filter @appshore/db prisma:migrate --create-only), run pnpm lint:schema, and amend the binding docs in this pull request if the model changed.
The event registry changed: event names match the vocabulary doc verbatim, and an event is raised through the outbox (OutboxService.transaction).
A route, DTO or serializer changed: regenerate and commit the OpenAPI documents (pnpm --filter @app/backend openapi:generate), and run pnpm verify:api before the pull request.
Configuration changed: a new or renamed variable goes into the config schema, the matching .env.example and the Doppler doc in this pull request.

A binding doc or ADR changed: that is an amendment, so the code it describes changes in the same pull request, and a changed decision gets a dated amendment in its ADR (the ADR index is docs/adr/README.md).

If this adds an import from another backend domain, domain-boundaries.spec.ts fails until the arrow is added to apps/backend/src/architecture/domain-boundaries.allowed.json; prefer a domain event to a sideways import.
The model catalog or route registry changed: every model call goes through the route resolver; model ids live only in the catalog, never in a skill or doc.
A send primitive changed: every outbound email, SMS, push, WhatsApp message and webhook goes through the outbound gate (outbound-gate-coverage.spec.ts holds it).

A workflow changed: CI is manual-only. workflow_dispatch is the only live trigger; a check workflow keeps its push and pull_request triggers commented out under the two-step note; a workflow on manualAlways in .claude/workflow.json carries none. pnpm guard:ci checks it.

The convention gate changed: the baseline is never edited or merged by hand; regenerate it with node tools/guards/convention-gate.mjs --update-baseline, which refuses a higher count (add --allow-moved when hits only moved to a renamed or split file).
